thread:
marta: Heads-up — we're onboarding Asteria-13B-Lite (NovaAI). License has a weird redistribution clause, want a quick triage before we start quant experiments.
samir: link to model card? where's the license text?
marta: https://models.nova.ai/asteria-13b-lite (see section 4). excerpt below:
```
4. Redistribution and Derivatives

The model weights ("Model") may not be redistributed, sublicensed, or bundled in whole or in part. Serving the Model via a hosted API is permitted provided attribution is displayed as described in Section 3. Derivative works that include modified weights (including quantized formats) are not permitted without explicit written consent from NovaAI.
```
liam-legal: quick read — sounds like a disallow on distributing weights and on making derivative weights (explicitly mentions quantized). Serving via API is allowed with attribution. key question: does "bundled" include internal-only packages/dev repos? probably yes.
anya: we're planning Dedicated evaluation (reserved GPUs) and then producing an 8-bit quant artifact to test perf/quality. If derivative weights are disallowed we can't push the quantized checkpoint to our internal package registry or artifact storage, right?
liam-legal: correct. If they prohibit derivatives, creating and storing a quantized checkpoint is technically a derivative distribution. You can run experiments in ephemeral infra that never stores QC artifacts outwardly, but pushing the quantized file to a repo or sharing with partners likely violates the clause.
compliance-bot: :warning: LICENSE_FLAG: redistribution-prohibited; derivative-weights-restricted
samir: operational question — is serving from our Dedicated cluster considered "hosting via hosted API" (allowed) or "redistribution" (disallowed)? we plan to host behind our API for customers.
liam-legal: serving from our infra to end users is "hosting/serving" and generally allowed per that clause so long as we don't distribute the weights to third parties. We should also meet the attribution requirement and check if there are any commercial-use restrictions elsewhere in the license.
marta: ok — action items: (1) run evals in Private/VPC or ephemeral Dedicated but don't store quantized checkpoints in internal artifact registry; (2) confirm attribution text in UI; (3) ask NovaAI for a commercial "serve-only" addendum that clarifies quantized artifacts and internal ephemeral artifacts. I'll draft an email.
anya: for evals: can we run 8-bit and 4-bit in-place (on ephemeral nodes) and collect metrics without producing an artifact? yes/no?
samir: yes — use ephemeral instance, run quant -> score -> discard artifacts. log only metrics and seed + config. do not rsync the checkpoint to central storage.
liam-legal: also check dataset provenance section — some models add restrictions on storing derived embeddings or using customer data for finetuning. don't assume free-for-all.
marta: noted. I'll ping NovaAI legal and loop in support engineering for ephemeral-run instructions. drafting now :memo: 
samir: +1
anya: thanks — will queue evals but will wait for the go-ahead on storage policy. :+1:
liam-legal: if they push back, we can request a narrow exception for internal-only quantized artifacts used solely for evaluation and not redistributed. that often works.
marta: cool. closing the triage for now — will post updates after NovaAI reply.
